issue.title: Refine Chat composer layout and add message avatars
issue.description:
Refine the existing Chat gallery card so the composer reads as an active chat action, stays anchored to the bottom of the full-height card, and message rows gain lightweight sender identity using the accepted shadcn Message/Avatar composition.

## Overall direction

* Preserve the simplified Chat card introduced in the previous polish phase.
* Do not reintroduce the old contact/name header.
* Keep the existing message bubbles and overall visual direction.
* Make the message region flex to use the available card height so the composer stays at the bottom edge.
* Keep the send action inside the composer field, but restore a clear button treatment and make it appear active.
* Add compact single-letter avatars beside messages using the accepted shadcn Message/Avatar pattern.

## 1. Composer and send action

Keep the composer field at the bottom of the Chat card.

* Preserve the placeholder exactly as `Type your message...`.
* Keep the send action inside the field at the far right.
* Restore the send action as a visibly filled icon button rather than a bare/muted icon.
* Use existing semantic primary styling/tokens rather than a one-off raw color.
* Make the send control appear enabled/active instead of disabled.
* Preserve keyboard/focus treatment appropriate for an active button.
* Do not add a new public primitive solely for this card.

Interaction boundary:

* No real message-send behavior is required in this ticket.
* Clicking the send button does not need to append messages, persist state, call a network/API, or introduce chat logic unless that behavior already exists and can be preserved without expanding scope.

## 2. Pin the composer to the bottom

Treat the card as a full-height chat surface.

* Let the conversation/message region expand vertically to consume the remaining available height.
* Keep the composer at the bottom edge of the card even when the message content itself does not fill the available space.
* Prefer normal layout structure such as a column flex/grid composition with an expanding message region.
* Avoid absolute positioning or brittle fixed-offset hacks.
* Preserve the accepted equal-height relationship with the paired Recent activity card where that pairing still applies.

## 3. Add message avatars

Use the accepted shadcn Message/Avatar composition as the reference pattern.

* Add a compact avatar beside incoming and outgoing message rows.
* Incoming messages place the avatar at the start/left side.
* Outgoing messages place the avatar at the end/right side, matching message alignment.
* Avatar images are not required.
* Use a simple single-letter `AvatarFallback` for each sender.
* Keep avatar treatment visually secondary to the message bubbles.
* Preserve current bubble copy and styling unless a small spacing/alignment adjustment is necessary for the avatar layout.
* Keep the composition compatible with grouped consecutive messages; do not hard-code unnecessary assumptions that every future bubble must always render its own avatar.

## 4. Reference implementation

Follow the accepted shadcn Message pattern where appropriate, including the relationship between:

* `Message`
* message alignment
* `MessageAvatar`
* the existing Avatar / AvatarFallback primitives

Reference:
[https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/message](<https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/message>)

Do not copy demo-specific imagery or content. The goal is the structural avatar/message relationship, adapted to the Personal UI theme and existing Chat card.

## 5. Theme, accessibility, and boundaries

* Continue using live Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Preserve light/dark behavior.
* Keep text, bubble, avatar, field, and button contrast appropriate.
* Preserve logical reading order.
* Preserve visible and programmatic focus states.
* Keep the send button accessible by keyboard and give it an appropriate accessible name.
* Do not add network requests, persistence, new dependencies, or new chat state.
* Do not modify Theme v3, mutation semantics, Design Command behavior, history, or public registry counts solely for this ticket.

## Acceptance

* Composer stays visually anchored to the bottom of the full-height Chat card.
* Message region expands to consume remaining vertical space instead of leaving the composer immediately after the last bubble.
* Placeholder remains exactly `Type your message...`.
* Send action remains inside the field at the far right.
* Send action uses a visible semantic filled button treatment and appears active/enabled.
* Send button has appropriate keyboard/focus and accessible-name behavior.
* No real send/message-insertion behavior is introduced.
* Incoming and outgoing message rows include compact single-letter avatars using the accepted shadcn Message/Avatar pattern.
* Avatar placement follows message alignment: start for incoming, end for outgoing.
* Old contact/name header is not reintroduced.
* Existing message copy and overall bubble styling remain intact except for necessary avatar/composer spacing.
* Chat continues to respond correctly to live theme changes and light/dark mode.
* No new dependency, network, persistence, public primitive, registry, Design Command, or theme regression.
